# NES test snapshots

RAM snapshots (internal RAM, the level map, and the block flags) recorded from level 1-1 of
[Nova the Squirrel](https://github.com/NovaSquirrel/NovaTheSquirrel) v1.0.6a by NovaSquirrel with
`bench/nes/verify_ram.py`. They contain the game's level data, which is licensed
[CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). These files are under that
license, not jevbrief's. No ROM or game code is included.
